columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: ACTION_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Stores ACTION_TRACKING_ID. Foreign key to irc_emp_event_action_trk table.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores action types supported values are ORA_MSG and ORA_NOTIFICATION.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Stores RECIPIENT_PERSON_ID. Foreign Key to per_persons table.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Stores recipient (Email) Address of the recipient.

columns.name: MESSAGE_DIRECTION
columns.description: Stores the message direction values are ORA_INBOUND and ORA_OUTBOUND.

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: Stores subject part for the message.

columns.name: BODY
columns.description: Stores body part for the message.

columns.name: MSG_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Stores Unified Message Service (UMS) message Id.

columns.name: MSG_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the message status as a lookup code. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_CMT_MSG_STATUS_TYPE.

columns.name: MSG_SENT_TS
columns.description: Stores message sent time  for this message.

columns.name: DELIVERY_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Stores the reason for error status of the execution.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Stores the ESS Job Request ID of the current recipient row.

columns.name: MSG_RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: stores current message retry count.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
